observations: Viewed both original cloud PNGs from the EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04 supplement. The new Compare file with OS CPUs button, summary table and bottom limitation text are visible.

The summary shows four matches, 28 reference APICs absent from available CPUs, and zero unmatched OS CPUs. Visible rows associate APICs 0x1c through 0x1f with OS CPUs 3, 2, 1, 0 and show L3 32 MiB / CPUID cache ID 1.
Missing reference APICs remain explicit rows. Group 1 appears before group 0, preserving the reference sorting rather than replacing raw positions with a physical CCD identity.

The bottom text says the reference sets differ or the available CPU set is partial, CPUID inputs were rechecked, origin/provider are unverified, physical/PM slots are not bound, and no settings were prepared or sent.

The prior tuning argument 1234 is visible unchanged. The scrollable table does not display all 32 reference candidates at once; complete row content is covered by Qt and CLI JSON assertions, not claimed as fully visible in these PNGs.
